## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`), as described in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build` and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] A change to an HTTP route or response describes its impact on the released phone and TV apps.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or pairing codes in code, tests or logs.
